name: ECA Remote Requests
description: Adds an ECA action to run outbound HTTP requests and a condition/action to handle their JSON responses within ECA workflows.
project_description:
Allows for remote requests to be made as part of an ECA model.

 Back to top 

 Features 
 Send remote requests to endpoints as part of the ECA workflow. As part of the response, JSON data can then be converted into list format and used as tokens throughout the flow.

 Back to top 

 Similar projects 
 HTTP Client Manager provides a way to create HTTP endpoints and manage them through code. This allows for the end user to reuse existing endpoints.
